integrity: The infinite statement is proved analytically from the published facet classification; the included exhaustive computation is explicitly auxiliary. Literature noncoverage is stated with a residual terminology risk rather than as an absolute novelty certificate.
scientific_limitations: Specific to complete multipartite symmetric edge polytopes in their standard root-vector realization and intrinsic Euclidean metric; no uniqueness of the Chebyshev center is claimed. Finite verification through n=8 corroborates but does not prove the arbitrary-n theorem.
title: Exact Euclidean inradius and tangent-facet phase of complete multipartite symmetric edge polytopes
